summary.scope: 27 parent only; n0 and n1; BASE and FINAL
summary.LOCAL_SHAPE_vs_LOCKED_RAW: No clear visible shape/support gain or loss at either stage for either noise. Tiny geometric changes remain uncertain at the supplied scale.
summary.restoration_vs_D0: ASSIST11, LOCKED_RAW and LOCAL_SHAPE retain substantial visible legs for both noises and stages; D0_ALL support is visibly threadlike or missing.
summary.remaining_cost: The restored variants still show apparent gaps around the thin upper rail and partial end arms. No obvious large competing layer/fold is visible. These visual gaps do not certify topological disconnection.
summary.BASE_to_FINAL: No clear macroscopic five-axis change within any method on these four pages.
summary.independent_axes: Reasonable overall shape and present support do not imply absence of visible gaps or correct topology.
